exposure: Alginate-aloe vera/ZnO NPs film plus mupirocin
outcome: Wound healing process (assessed by REEDA wound scale: redness, ecchymosis, edema, CS approximation)
cohort: 800 pregnant women who underwent Cesarean Section (CS) at the second affiliated hospital of Xi'an Medical School.
finding: The alginate-aloe vera/ZnO NPs film plus mupirocin treatment resulted in significantly lower values of redness, ecchymosis, edema, and CS approximation, leading to a faster recovery process compared to the control group.
mod_finding: The study focuses on post-cesarean wound healing but does not compare different modes of birth; therefore, findings related to mode of birth are N/A.
